domains.name: Child Maltreatment History (Caused)
domains.summary: Indicates whether the person has a history of being a victim or perpetrator of child maltreatment, including types and outcomes.

domains.name: Substance Abuse History (Contributed)
domains.summary: Records the person's history of substance abuse, specifying types and prior deaths related to abuse.

domains.name: Age and Legal Outcomes (Contributed)
domains.summary: Includes age information and legal outcomes such as charges filed or dismissed for the contributing factors.

domains.name: Disability and Chronic Illness (Contributed)
domains.summary: Documents whether the person has a disability or chronic illness, including mental and physical conditions.

domains.name: Child Abuse and Neglect Types
domains.summary: Categorizes types of child abuse (e.g., emotional) and neglect (e.g., emotional neglect).
